blocks.text: Stars of the ‘90s youth-oriented series “T.G.I.S.” and popular love teams Francine Diaz and Seth Fedelin (FranSeth) and Mika Salamanca and Brent Manalo (MikBrent) are set to headline the upcoming holiday anthology series “Paskong Pinoy.” The trailer, released over the weekend, features four separate Christmas-themed narratives, beginning with Diaz and Fedelin playing perfect strangers whose paths cross in a winter wonderland. Another story follows two sisters with contrasting personalities, portrayed by Kaila Estrada and Salamanca, as they navigate family complications alongside JC Santos and Manalo.
